text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I told you it's no big deal. I just twisted it a little when I stepped down.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You didn't need to take me to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I already feel fine. Are you listening? I need to keep training.
choice_data_list: You really think you're in the shape to continue?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't have time to lie around. I need to be on my feet and running. I…
choice_data_list: It takes strength to overcome impatience.
That's so like you. All right, but be careful.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: Let's wait until you're fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Fine… I got it. I'll get some rest then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although somewhat reluctant, Admire Vega listens to my advice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's only a light injury. I can still move—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: Never mind. We need to go back to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I escort the dejected Admire Vega back to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. It wasn't a serious injury in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You don't need to keep looking at it. You're messing up my concentration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega returns to training while being careful not to worsen her injury.
